description: A wind chime of five brass tubes (60 cm long) on a garden shepherd's hook (2.3 m); it tinkles gently in the breeze. Stands in a garden or by a porch.

name: core-campfire
description: A campfire in a ring of stones (1.6 m) with crossed logs and flames that crackle while it burns; sit round it on three logs. Light it and put it out ("put out the fire").
